stage0025_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ EFF Far East Branch, Director's Office ～

stage0025_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$レディ$$
「Well done, all units.
　I'm glad we could safely regroup like this.」

stage0025_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$大塚$$
「But the situation isn't looking good.」

stage0025_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$城田$$
「Yes...
　The situation's worsening on every front.」

stage0025_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$オットー$$
「In space, Neo Zeon's movements are intensifying.」

stage0025_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$オットー$$
「Londo Bell's Commander $$ブライト$$ believes that if
　these incidents keep recurring, they'll spark
　a war between Earth and space.」

stage0025_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So a person preaching Earth-colony harmony
　suddenly changed heart, sparking riots...」

stage0025_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$オットー$$
「I also witnessed a joint exercise with the
　colony forces turn into a killing match between
　Earth and colony sides.」

stage0025_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So the cause remains unknown, even now...」

stage0025_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$オットー$$
「And as if in response to that movement,
　$$マリーメイア・クシュリナーダ$$ issued a declaration
　of war.」

stage0025_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$オットー$$
「This is unofficial, so it's not yet known
　to the public, but they're expected to join
　forces with Neo Zeon.」

stage0025_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$大塚$$
「Neo Zeon and $$マリーメイア$$... plus $$プラント$$ joining
　in, a colony alliance. So the day it goes to
　all out war with the Federation is close...」

stage0025_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$レディ$$
「To prevent that from happening, the $$大統領$$
　is placing great weight on talks with Neo
　Zeon's representative, $$ハマーン$$.」

stage0025_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$城田$$
「If only relations could improve there...」

stage0025_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I hear things were rough in Japan too.」

stage0025_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$大塚$$
「Hmm...
　An Angel we've long been wary of has
　finally appeared.」

stage0025_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$大塚$$
「NERV, founded to counter the Angels,
　somehow managed to drive it off, thanks to
　Evangelion, their humanoid decisive weapon.」

stage0025_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$城田$$
「Currently, two Evangelions and their
　respective pilots have joined the Crusher Team.」

stage0025_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Both of them are fourteen...
　Still young enough to call a boy and a girl.」

stage0025_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$大塚$$
「Furthermore, we learned that the aliens who
　appeared before serve one called the 'Demon King'.」

stage0025_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$オットー$$
「That unit of mysterious flying saucers?」

stage0025_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But, the Demon King, is it...」

stage0025_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$大塚$$
「Also, apparently there were psychics from
　planet Gishin among that group as well.」

stage0025_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is the Demon King Emperor $$ズール$$, who ruled Gishin?」

stage0025_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$大塚$$
「According to $$タケル$$, who fought them firsthand,
　the Demon King behind them seems to differ from $$ズール$$.」

stage0025_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$大塚$$
「Its immense size, coldness, and horror,
　though, are apparently shared traits.」

stage0025_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$レディ$$
「There's also a group scheming behind that situation.」

stage0025_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$大塚$$
「《$$マーティアル$$》, is it...」

stage0025_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$レディ$$
「$$マーティアル$$, a religious order that originates
　in $$アストラギウス$$, holds to a doctrine that conflict
　drives humanity's evolution.」

stage0025_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Behind the underground $$バトリング$$ held in
　$$ア・コバ$$, Mexico, was that same $$マーティアル$$.」

stage0025_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And it's safe to assume $$マーティアル$$ was also
　behind the terrorists that appeared in $$第２新東京市$$
　and the Hanka Autonomous Region.」

stage0025_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$大塚$$
「In space, Neo Zeon and $$マリーメイア$$; on the
　ground, the Demon King's group, Angels, and
　the Mechanical Beast army... And $$マーティアル$$ too...」

stage0025_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Behind this seemingly peaceful world,
　the sparks of conflict steadily spread...」

stage0025_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$レディ$$
「To deal with all of that, we've had
　everyone regroup here once again.」

stage0025_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$レディ$$
「To keep future operations running smoothly,
　we've asked the $$大統領$$ to approve a new,
　more flexible independent unit.」

stage0025_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So that will become our new battleground, then...」

stage0025_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$大塚$$
「Hmm...
　It's a shame $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ have to
　gather together again like this, though...」

stage0025_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Eh... ah... I heard what sounded like a scream...」

stage0025_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$n
「It's just your imagination.
　...Did you need something, coming to my room?」

stage0025_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Sounds like everyone who's been fighting all
　over is swapping notes in the Quarter's hangar.
　Want to go show our faces too?」

stage0025_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$スズネ$$
「We should learn the new members' faces too...」

stage0025_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$n
「Go to the hangar, hear the other units out」
「Don't go to the hangar」

stage0025_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$n
「...Understood.
　It's probably good to know what enemies
　the other units have been fighting, too.」

stage0025_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Being eager to learn is a good thing.
　Put that much effort into schoolwork too, okay?」

stage0025_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah, that's right.
　The sea near $$第３新東京市$$, where that Angel
　appeared, has turned red.」

stage0025_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$リディ$$
「Isn't that odd, though?
　The sea connects all around the world, so
　I'd think that red sea would dilute fast...」

stage0025_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$さやか$$
「According to hyperdimensional physicists,
　that phenomenon happens because the world that
　arrived via the $$新世時空震動$$ hasn't blended in.」

stage0025_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$エマ$$
「I recall hearing the red sea comes from a
　third world, after $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$...」

stage0025_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's right.
　In that world, its sea turned red from a disaster
　fifteen years back called $$セカンドインパクト$$.」

stage0025_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So it transferred here via the $$新世時空震動$$,
　but the world itself hasn't blended in well.」

stage0025_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Guess you just take it at face value.
　That red sea's phase is apparently off, so
　it won't mix with this world's sea.」

stage0025_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then some small trigger might cause the third
　world to transfer over here again.」

stage0025_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$葵$$
「Well, given how stable the dimensional
　boundary is now, a $$時空震動$$ won't happen easily.」

stage0025_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$エマ$$
「The problem is that Angel, though.」

stage0025_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah.
　If an Angel reaches NERV HQ in $$第３新東京市$$,
　Third Impact happens and the world ends.」

stage0025_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What kind of mechanism causes this
　Third Impact to happen, anyway?」

stage0025_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$くらら$$
「That's something we haven't been told either.」

stage0025_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$葵$$
「NERV, set up to intercept the Angels,
　seems pretty secretive about a lot of things.」

stage0025_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$葵$$
「So that's why we haven't gotten any info
　passed down to us, not about the Angels,
　nor about that Third Impact.」

stage0025_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（It's only been a few months since I came
　to this world, yet this organization called
　NERV... why does it hold so much power...）

stage0025_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$赤木$$
「But it's not all bad, you know.
　That Commander Ikari guy went and sent the
　Crusher Team his prized Evangelion.」

stage0025_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$リディ$$
「So you're the pilot of $$ダイ・ガード$$, the anti-
　《$$ヘテロダイン$$》 robot owned by 21st Century
　Security.」

stage0025_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
Akagi
「That's right.
　I'm $$赤木駿介$$, PR Section 2 at 21st
　Century Security, and $$ダイ・ガード$$'s pilot.」

stage0025_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
Ibuki
「Also here, I'm the navigator, $$桃井いぶき$$.」

stage0025_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
Aoyama
「I'm the engineer, $$青山圭一郎$$.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0025_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$リディ$$
「I've heard about your exploits.
　That despite being civilians, you're
　professionals at handling $$ヘテロダイン$$s.」

stage0025_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$青山$$
「Though, maybe since the dimensional boundary
　stabilized, 《$$界震$$》s stopped happening
　altogether, so we joined the Crusher Team.」

stage0025_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't complain, $$青山$$.
　It's a good thing $$ヘテロダイン$$s aren't showing up.」

stage0025_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$赤木$$
「Above all, let's be glad we get to work
　for peace with the Crusher Team.」

stage0025_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're as much a hero of justice as ever, $$赤木$$.」

stage0025_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$リディ$$
「That guts... I'll try to learn from it.」

stage0025_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$赤木$$
「Hold on a second.
　I'm not the only salaryman protecting peace.
　It's all of PR Section 2.」

stage0025_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$大杉$$
「I'm $$大杉$$, the section chief.
　We've formally accepted the Far East Branch's
　request, and will be accompanying you all.」

stage0025_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
Yokozawa
「I'm $$横沢晋也$$, assistant section chief.
　And these are the section's members.」

stage0025_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
Ooyama
「I'm $$大山紀子$$.
　Following on from $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, I'm helping out
　with the Crusher Team.」

stage0025_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
Nakahara
「I'm $$中原千秋$$.
　I'll do my very best.」

stage0025_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
Tanigawa
「I'm $$谷川風花$$.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0025_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
Irie
「I'm $$入江静香$$.
　Pleased to make your acquaintance.」

stage0025_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
Ishizuka
「I'm $$石塚智美$$.
　And these are $$田口友朗$$ and $$伊集院博孝$$.」

stage0025_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$伊集院$$
「Nice to meetcha.
　A pleasure to meet you.」

stage0025_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
Saeki
「Last but not least, I'm $$佐伯徹$$,
　dispatched by the military as a tactical
　advisor. I mainly direct $$ダイ・ガード$$'s operations.」

stage0025_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$青山$$
「Everyone's basically been dragged along
　by $$赤木$$'s justice-freak antics to get here.」

stage0025_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It's fine, isn't it?
　It's got 'justice' stuck on the front, after all.」

stage0025_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$甲児$$
「There's others who got inspired by
　that guts of $$赤木$$'s, too.」

stage0025_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$甲児$$
「These two here are the rumored Evangelion pilots.」

stage0025_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
Shinji
「Pilot of $$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$,
　I'm $$碇シンジ$$.」

stage0025_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Yeah.
　$$シンジ$$'s Commander Ikari's son.」

stage0025_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
Misato
「I'm Lt. Col. $$葛城ミサト$$ of NERV.
　I've been assigned to the Crusher Team as
　the one in charge of EVA operations.」

stage0025_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Don't worry too much about rank.
　This unit's got people from all sorts of
　organizations, so let's keep it casual.」

stage0025_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So, all of you kids...
　you can just call me $$ミサト$$, that's fine」

stage0025_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ミサト$$
「And this here is the Evangelion
　Unit-00 pilot, $$綾波レイ$$」

stage0025_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$甲児$$
「What's wrong, $$カミーユ$$?
　Are you smitten with $$レイ#333$$?」

stage0025_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「N-no... it's not like that, but...」

stage0025_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（What is this feeling...
　her presence, it just feels off...）

stage0025_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$タケル$$
「With EVA and $$ダイ・ガード$$ joining in,
　the Crusher Team's gotten stronger」

stage0025_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$甲児$$
「And $$タケル$$ and the others are back too」

stage0025_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Oh right, $$タケル$$ and the others went to space...」

stage0025_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$タケル$$
「Yeah.
　With the Frontier fleet's help, we used
　Fold Wave observation to survey space」

stage0025_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$タケル$$
「No...
　we were checking the black hole at the galaxy's core」

stage0025_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
Takeru
「Oh, I forgot to introduce myself.
　I'm $$明神タケル$$...
　I pilot $$ゴッドマーズ$$, and my space name is Mars」

stage0025_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'm not from Earth.
　I'm from planet Gishin. Mars is the name I got there」

stage0025_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
Takeru
「As a kid, I was sent to Earth from planet Gishin,
　and a couple there, the Myojins, took me in
　and gave me the name $$明神タケル$$」

stage0025_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$葵$$
「$$タケル$$'s also a psychic, you know」

stage0025_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$タケル$$
「I intend to use $$ゴッドマーズ$$ and my psychic powers
　for the sake of peace in the universe.
　I look forward to working with you all」

stage0025_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$タケル$$
「Now, let me introduce the rest of the Crusher Team」

stage0025_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「I'm $$ロゼ$$.
　I'm not from Earth either, but I'm helping Mars,
　who fights for peace」

stage0025_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$エマ$$
「Heh... so that's how it is...」

stage0025_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$リディ$$
「Wait... what...?
　What do you mean?」

stage0025_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$'s pretty dense about that stuff」

stage0025_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$ロゼ$$ rides in the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ too,
　and fights alongside us」

stage0025_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
Naoto
「And the $$コスモクラッシャー$$'s gunner
　is me, $$伊集院ナオト$$」

stage0025_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
Mika
「I'm the comms officer, $$日向ミカ$$」

stage0025_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
Kenji
「And I'm the Crusher Team's captain, $$飛鳥ケンジ$$」

stage0025_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$リディ$$
「With this much firepower gathered,
　we've nothing to fear from this so-called Demon King」

stage0025_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$アルト$$
「The Japan group's really grown its ranks,
　hasn't it? Quite lively now」

stage0025_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Been a while, $$アルト$$.
　Good to see the Skull Squadron's all doing well」

stage0025_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アルト$$
「It's been a while, Captain $$アムロ$$」

stage0025_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$バナージ$$
「So you all were fighting alongside Londo Bell too」

stage0025_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アルト$$
「I was surprised too.
　Who knew $$沙慈$$'s friends would end up
　riding the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$」

stage0025_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I got to read the report
　on $$ミスリル$$ and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$'s joint operation」

stage0025_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アルト$$
「The underground $$バトリング$$ in the town of $$ア・コバ$$
　was a testing ground for a Balarant unit
　that worships $$マーティアル$$」

stage0025_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's right.
　They were testing a new 《$$ＰＳ$$》 there」

stage0025_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Perfect Soldier...
　Enhanced soldiers $$アストラギウス$$ made artificially, huh...」

stage0025_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That $$ニーバ$$, the $$ＰＳ$$, was quite the tough foe,
　but the real problem was $$マーティアル$$ behind it all」

stage0025_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アルト$$
「The soldier they sent, one named $$テイタニア$$,
　was skilled enough to match $$キリコ$$, or better」

stage0025_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アルト$$
「And then, that one went and took $$フィアナ$$ away」

stage0025_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$シン$$
「Just what for, doing something like that...?
　Is $$マーティアル$$ after $$ＰＳ$$ too...?」

stage0025_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「It's not confirmed,
　but from what that woman $$テイタニア$$ said,
　it sounds like a trap to lure out $$キリコ$$」

stage0025_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Being an 《$$異能生存体$$》 sounds rough.
　One headache after another comes your way」

stage0025_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャッコ$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$...
　Never thought I'd run into you two again」

stage0025_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「I swore to help $$キリコ$$.
　I just go wherever he goes」

stage0025_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I got tired of babysitting the boy,
　so I tossed him out」

stage0025_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「This woman says she's interested in $$マーティアル$$」

stage0025_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I got curious to see the faces
　of people who worship some god of war」

stage0025_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$バナージ$$
（So this is $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$...
　An executive of the Black Knights,
　the resistance group that challenged the world...）

stage0025_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$シン$$ jokingly called her
　a 'witch', though...）

stage0025_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「What's wrong, boy?
　Am I really that interesting to you?」

stage0025_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Such a fresh reaction.
　I've been dealing with nothing but jaded boys
　lately, so this is nice for a change」

stage0025_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Oh... you sure are looking out for this boy」

stage0025_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I feel like his guardian.
　It's something like your relationship with 'him'」

stage0025_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You'll find out eventually.
　Including why I'm called a witch」

stage0025_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Wait... did you... read my mind?」

stage0025_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're too easy to read.
　One look at your face tells me what you're thinking」

stage0025_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Guess that personality of yours hasn't changed」

stage0025_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シン$$
「$$アルト$$...
　How's $$キリコ$$ doing?」

stage0025_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$アルト$$
「Now that it's clear $$マーティアル$$ is behind the terrorism,
　$$ミスリル$$'s apparently starting a full investigation.
　We're waiting on that information now」

stage0025_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$シン$$
「That's surprising...
　I figured he'd go alone to get
　$$フィアナ$$ back, knowing him...」

stage0025_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アルト$$
「...Actually, $$フィアナ$$'s health isn't good, apparently」

stage0025_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even having a doctor look at her,
　a $$ＰＳ$$, it had no effect, apparently...」

stage0025_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アルト$$
「So $$キリコ$$ entrusted her to $$マーティアル$$,
　betting on their power to heal her」

stage0025_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$マーティアル$$'s gaining believers
　even outside $$アストラギウス$$ now...
　we'll need to be careful）

stage0025_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$アムロ$$
（And it worries me too
　that $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ has taken an interest in $$マーティアル$$...）

stage0025_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$甲児$$
「But why are you with Londo Bell?
　I heard you went back to 《$$ザフト$$》...」

stage0025_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$シン$$
「My unit ran into a Neo Zeon terror attack.
　After fighting them off, I decided to just
　keep operating together with Londo Bell」

stage0025_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$さやか$$
「$$ザフト$$'s the military of 《$$プラント$$》, right?
　Is it really okay to decide that so easily?」

stage0025_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$シン$$
「I may not look it, but I'm 《$$ＦＡＩＴＨ$$》.
　I've got the right to decide my own actions」

stage0025_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Turns out you're a surprisingly amazing guy」

stage0025_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$くらら$$
「How are $$ルナマリア$$ and the others doing?」

stage0025_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$シン$$
「$$キラ$$, $$アスラン$$, and Luna are in $$プラント$$」

stage0025_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「What's wrong?
　Is something bothering you...?」

stage0025_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$シン$$
「$$ラクス$$ and everyone are doing their best,
　but $$プラント$$'s leaning anti-Earth Federation too」

stage0025_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$シン$$
「Sure, the Earth Federation has its problems now,
　but if they team up with Neo Zeon, all that
　waits after that is more war...」

stage0025_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$甲児$$
「Sounds like space has had it rough too」

stage0025_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah...
　With people like $$マリーメイア$$ showing up now,
　we're headed straight for war at this rate」

stage0025_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Just who are
　this $$マリーメイア$$ bunch, anyway?」

stage0025_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$デュオ$$
「The Barton Foundation, based out of
　the L3 colony, is their parent group」

stage0025_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$タケル$$
「Barton... isn't that $$トロワ$$'s last name?」

stage0025_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Trowa's name, $$トロワ・バートン$$,
　is apparently an alias」

stage0025_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「And that Barton Foundation
　was also the sponsor
　behind 《$$オペレーション・メテオ$$》」

stage0025_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$デュオ$$
「But their real goal wasn't
　colony liberation, it was to make
　themselves rulers of the Earth Sphere」

stage0025_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「So they took advantage of the chaos to attack」

stage0025_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「But $$マリーメイア$$ sounds
　like a girl's name, though...」

stage0025_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Bang on, actually.
　Their leader's still a little girl...
　by the name of $$マリーメイア・クシュリナーダ$$」

stage0025_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$タケル$$
「Is she related to that
　《$$トレーズ$$》 Khushrenada?」

stage0025_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$デュオ$$
「By her own account, she's $$トレーズ$$'s daughter,
　and the rightful heir to $$ＡＤＷ$$'s ruler」

stage0025_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$甲児$$
「There's already an Earth Federation,
　so what's this $$マリーメイア$$ kid even saying...」

stage0025_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That kid's basically a figurehead.
　The one pulling the strings is the old man
　on top of Barton Foundation, $$デキム・バートン$$」

stage0025_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「$$プリベンター$$ was investigating the Barton
　Foundation's suspicious moves, but they
　acted faster than we expected」

stage0025_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$タケル$$
「So you and the others are piloting Gundams again」

stage0025_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah, well.
　After the $$再世戦争$$, $$カトル$$ sealed away
　our Gundams since we didn't need them, but...」

stage0025_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Given the situation,
　$$カトル$$ entrusted the Gundams to $$プリベンター$$,
　and I delivered them to $$デュオ$$ and $$ヒイロ$$」

stage0025_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$葵$$
「So you've been helping $$プリベンター$$
　alongside $$デュオ$$ too, $$ヒルデ$$」

stage0025_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$甲児$$
「What are the other three
　Gundam pilots up to?」

stage0025_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$デュオ$$
「$$カトル$$ and $$トロワ$$ are moving on their own,
　gathering info on $$マリーメイア$$」

stage0025_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「He's sided with $$マリーメイア$$」

stage0025_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$甲児$$
「So that makes him your enemy now?」

stage0025_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$デュオ$$
「He's got his own reasons, I bet.
　He was always hard to read anyway」

stage0025_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「What we need to worry about now
　is a Neo Zeon and $$マリーメイア$$ alliance」

stage0025_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Now I'm the wind that smothers fires...
　I go by the $$プリベンター$$ code Wind」

stage0025_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$朔哉$$
「You led the 《$$ホワイトファング$$》 and caused
　all that carnage, and now you just
　waltz on in here...!」

stage0025_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Not even going to make excuses?」

stage0025_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I already died once.
　I left my past behind there」

stage0025_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Let him prove his resolve in the fights ahead」

stage0025_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I don't think that atones for my sins,
　but I mean to make this life a foundation for peace」

stage0025_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$朔哉$$
「But if you slack off even a little,
　I won't let it slide」

stage0025_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ノイン$$
「Then I'll take on watching over $$ゼクス$$」

stage0025_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「So Miss $$ノイン$$ has joined up too」

stage0025_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ノイン$$
「The $$プリベンター$$s exist to preserve peace,
　and that work was meant to be done
　out of the public eye...」

stage0025_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ノイン$$
「But sadly, things are only accelerating.
　I too mean to lend my strength to peace, regrettably」

stage0025_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I've been transferred from the $$ラー・カイラム$$
　to the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ as well.
　Count on me again, everyone」

stage0025_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Likewise, pleased to be working with you」

stage0025_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$くらら$$
（Has Captain $$アムロ$$ changed a little?）

stage0025_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$葵$$
（Feels like he's grown up a bit.
　Not bad）

stage0025_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Good timing.
　Let me introduce him to everyone.
　...$$バナージ$$!」

stage0025_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
Banagher
「I'm $$バナージ・リンクス$$.
　I'm currently working as a test pilot
　for the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$」

stage0025_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$バナージ$$ got caught up in the Neo Zeon
　terrorist attack on Industrial 7...」

stage0025_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He fought in that $$ユニコーンガンダム$$,
　and ended up joining us on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$」

stage0025_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$タケル$$
「Unicorn... that's the white
　one-horned mobile suit from over there...」

stage0025_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$葵$$
「Doesn't really look like a Gundam though」

stage0025_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「That's where you'd be wrong!
　That Unicorn transforms」

stage0025_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「That single horn splits into a V-fin.
　The rest of its parts unfold too,
　and out comes a proper Gundam」

stage0025_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But for the Unicorn to transform,
　a system called the NT-D has to activate,
　and the conditions for that are still unknown」

stage0025_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$タケル$$
「So it can't transform freely, then」

stage0025_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right.
　That's part of why we have $$バナージ$$
　working as a test pilot, to figure it out」

stage0025_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$...!
　Stop revealing classified matters to civilians!」

stage0025_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「They're comrades we'll be fighting alongside.
　Wanting to share basic information about
　a wingman seems only natural, don't you think?」

stage0025_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That may be so, but...」

stage0025_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't worry, $$アルベルト$$.
　I think I understand Anaheim's situation too.
　I won't do anything to hurt the company's interests」

stage0025_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Very well, then, that's fine.
　Now, if you'll excuse me...」

stage0025_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アルベルト・ビスト$$.
　An Anaheim executive」

stage0025_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「I'd peg him as the type who hides behind
　authority to get his way. Common enough in business」

stage0025_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「That old man's supposed to be watching
　over the Unicorn, but he's full of complaints
　about $$バナージ$$ being the test pilot」

stage0025_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Can't be helped.
　The Unicorn can only be piloted by $$バナージ$$,
　since it's keyed to his biometric data」

stage0025_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The chance entrusted to me by $$カーディアス・ビスト$$...
　by father... I'll protect $$オードリー$$ with that Unicorn...）

stage0025_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Well... thanks to them wanting $$バナージ$$
　as pilot, me and $$ミコット$$ and $$オードリー$$
　all got hired along with him too」

stage0025_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$甲児$$
「I see.
　So that's why $$タクヤ$$ and $$ミコット$$
　are also aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$」

stage0025_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ミコット$$
「$$沙慈$$ and I got separated
　during the fighting on Industrial 7, though...」

stage0025_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$タケル$$
「Knowing him, though.
　I'm sure he's fine」

stage0025_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
Audrey
「My name is $$オードリー・バーン$$.
　Pleased to meet you」

stage0025_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$バナージ$$
「She got caught up in the fighting too,
　and with nowhere else to go, she came
　aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ with us」

stage0025_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$甲児$$
「I see...
　That must have been rough」

stage0025_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you for your concern」

stage0025_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$朔哉$$
「You're... some kind of rich girl, huh?」

stage0025_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$朔哉$$
「You can't hide it.
　It shows in every word and gesture」

stage0025_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's leave that sort of thing alone.
　From now on, we've got no choice but
　to make this work here on this ship」

stage0025_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$くらら$$
「Prying into other people's pasts is tasteless」

stage0025_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you, $$バナージ$$.
　For throwing me a lifeline」

stage0025_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$オードリー$$ seems to have some kind of past,
　but I won't think about that now...
　she chose to come with us...）

stage0025_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アムロ$$...
　are you sure you shouldn't tell everyone about that?」

stage0025_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Could that really...
　not be Captain $$クワトロ$$ after all...?」

stage0025_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I denied it, but the unease remains.
　Telling $$甲児$$ and the others now
　would only cause needless confusion」

stage0025_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$... where are you right now...
　I believe you won't make a foolish choice...）

stage0025_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$赤木$$
「Been a while, $$アルト$$.
　Same to the rest of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$」

stage0025_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$アルト$$
「You and yours haven't changed either」

stage0025_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$青山$$
「Heard you went off to crush underground $$バトリング$$」

stage0025_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You with $$２１世紀警備保障$$ too?」

stage0025_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「It takes one to know one...
　seems like $$青山$$ and $$クルツ$$
　have recognized each other as equals」

stage0025_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$マオ$$
「Better not to ask, I think.
　Just a hunch, though」

stage0025_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Feels like we'll know each other a while, $$青山$$」

stage0025_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$青山$$
「Seems that way.
　Good to know you, $$クルツ$$」

stage0025_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$赤木$$
「Not sure I follow,
　but hitting it off is a good thing」

stage0025_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So, $$アルト$$...
　did you enjoy that underground $$バトリング$$ or whatever?」

stage0025_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$アルト$$
「It really was a lawless town.
　The $$バトリング$$ there took $$リアルバトル$$
　for granted. It was outrageous」

stage0025_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$アルト$$
「On top of that, the place was
　also a testing ground for a Balarant unit
　devoted to the $$マーティアル$$ Order」

stage0025_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$アルト$$
「They were testing a new 《$$ＰＳ$$》 there」

stage0025_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Perfect Soldier...
　an artificially enhanced soldier born of $$アストラギウス$$...」

stage0025_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That $$ニーバ$$, the $$ＰＳ$$, was quite the tough foe,
　but the real problem was $$マーティアル$$ behind it all」

stage0025_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$アルト$$
「The soldier they sent, one named $$テイタニア$$,
　was skilled enough to match $$キリコ$$, or better」

stage0025_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$アルト$$
「And then, that one went and took $$フィアナ$$ away」

stage0025_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「What in the world was that for...?
　Do those so-called $$マーティアル$$ Order people
　want a $$ＰＳ$$ too?」

stage0025_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「It's not confirmed,
　but from what that woman $$テイタニア$$ said,
　it sounds like a trap to lure out $$キリコ$$」

stage0025_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Being an 《$$異能生存体$$》 sounds rough.
　One headache after another comes your way」

stage0025_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So $$シャッコ$$ and $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ were also
　aboard the Quarter」

stage0025_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「I swore to help $$キリコ$$.
　I just go wherever he goes」

stage0025_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I got tired of babysitting the boy,
　so I tossed him out」

stage0025_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「This woman says she's interested in $$マーティアル$$」

stage0025_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I got curious to see the faces
　of people who worship some god of war」

stage0025_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Still every bit the witch, I see」

stage0025_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$アルト$$...
　is $$キリコ$$ going to be okay?」

stage0025_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$アルト$$
「Now that we know the $$マーティアル$$ Order
　is behind the terrorism, $$ミスリル$$'s starting
　a full investigation, so we're waiting on word」

stage0025_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's surprising...
　I figured he'd go get $$フィアナ$$ back
　on his own, knowing him...」

stage0025_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$アルト$$
「...Actually, $$フィアナ$$'s not doing well」

stage0025_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even having $$ＰＳ$$'s girl seen by a doctor
　didn't do any good, apparently...」

stage0025_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$アルト$$
「So $$キリコ$$ left her with the $$マーティアル$$ Order,
　betting on their power to cure her.」

stage0025_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Having to leave the girl he's fallen for
　in the hands of some unknown bunch...
　That's rough...」

stage0025_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Since the $$マーティアル$$ Order's target is $$キリコ$$,
　that woman should be treated as a guest.」

stage0025_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（And what the $$マーティアル$$ Order truly wants is...）

stage0025_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Why are you with Londo Bell?
　I heard you'd gone back to 《$$ザフト$$》...」

stage0025_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$シン$$
「My unit ran into a Neo Zeon terror attack.
　After fighting them off, I decided to just
　keep operating together with Londo Bell」

stage0025_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Isn't $$ザフト$$ 《$$プラント$$》's military?
　Is it really okay to decide that so easily?」

stage0025_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$シン$$
「I may not look it, but I'm 《$$ＦＡＩＴＨ$$》.
　I've got the right to decide my own actions」

stage0025_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$クラン$$
「I've changed my opinion of you, $$シン$$.
　Turns out you're surprisingly impressive.」

stage0025_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$シン$$
「That's rude in more ways than one, Captain.」

stage0025_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Aren't $$ルナマリア$$ and the others with you?」

stage0025_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$シン$$
「$$キラ$$, $$アスラン$$, and Luna are in $$プラント$$」

stage0025_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$オズマ$$
「What's wrong?
　Is something bothering you...?」

stage0025_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$シン$$
「$$ラクス$$ and everyone are doing their best,
　but $$プラント$$'s leaning anti-Federation too.」

stage0025_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$シン$$
「Sure, the Earth Federation has its problems now,
　but if they team up with Neo Zeon, all that
　waits after that is more war...」

stage0025_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Sounds like space has been rough too.」

stage0025_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah...
　With people like $$マリーメイア$$ showing up now,
　we're headed straight for war at this rate」

stage0025_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$アルト$$
「So what kind of organization
　is this $$マリーメイア$$ thing?」

stage0025_03:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$デュオ$$
「The Barton Foundation, based out of
　the L3 colony, is their parent group」

stage0025_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$アルト$$
「Barton... isn't that $$トロワ$$'s last name?」

stage0025_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Trowa's name, $$トロワ・バートン$$,
　is apparently an alias」

stage0025_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$デュオ$$
「And that Barton Foundation
　was also the sponsor
　behind 《$$オペレーション・メテオ$$》」

stage0025_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「But their real goal wasn't
　colony liberation, it was to make
　themselves rulers of the Earth Sphere」

stage0025_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$クラン$$
「So they used the chaos to start a fight?」

stage0025_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「But $$マリーメイア$$ sounds like
　a girl's name...」

stage0025_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Bang on, actually.
　Their leader's still a little girl...
　by the name of $$マリーメイア・クシュリナーダ$$」

stage0025_03:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Is she related to that
　《$$トレーズ$$》 Khushrenada?」

stage0025_03:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$デュオ$$
「By her own account, she's $$トレーズ$$'s daughter,
　and the rightful heir to $$ＡＤＷ$$'s ruler」

stage0025_03:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$アルト$$
「The Earth Federation already exists!
　What's that $$マリーメイア$$ kid thinking!」

stage0025_03:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That kid's basically a figurehead.
　The one pulling the strings is the old man
　on top of Barton Foundation, $$デキム・バートン$$」

stage0025_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「$$プリベンター$$ was investigating the Barton
　Foundation's suspicious moves, but they
　acted faster than we expected」

stage0025_03:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$ルカ$$
「So you and the others are
　piloting Gundams again, huh.」

stage0025_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah, well.
　After the $$再世戦争$$, $$カトル$$ sealed away
　our Gundams since we didn't need them, but...」

stage0025_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Given the situation,
　$$カトル$$ entrusted the Gundams to $$プリベンター$$,
　and I delivered them to $$デュオ$$ and $$ヒイロ$$」

stage0025_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$クラン$$
「So $$ヒルデ$$'s been helping the $$プリベンター$$s
　along with $$デュオ$$ too.」

stage0025_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「What are the other three
　Gundam pilots up to?」

stage0025_03:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「$$カトル$$ and $$トロワ$$ are moving on their own,
　gathering info on $$マリーメイア$$」

stage0025_03:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「He's sided with $$マリーメイア$$」

stage0025_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$クラン$$
「You mean he's become your enemy?」

stage0025_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$デュオ$$
「He's got his own reasons, I bet.
　He was always hard to read anyway」

stage0025_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「What we need to worry about now
　is a Neo Zeon and $$マリーメイア$$ alliance」

stage0025_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Now I'm the wind that smothers fires...
　I go by the $$プリベンター$$ code Wind」

stage0025_03:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$アルト$$
「You led the 《$$ホワイトファング$$》 and caused
　that much of a war, and now you're
　doing this act, of all things...!」

stage0025_03:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So you're not going to make excuses?」

stage0025_03:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I already died once.
　I left my past behind there」

stage0025_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$アルト$$
「You think logic like that will fly...!?」

stage0025_03:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$オズマ$$
「We're warriors.
　Proving ourselves doesn't take words.」

stage0025_03:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That's my intent as well. I don't believe
　it will atone for my sins, but this life...
　I'll make it a cornerstone for peace.」

stage0025_03:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$アルト$$
「But if those words turn out to be a lie,
　you'd better be ready for what comes.」

stage0025_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$ノイン$$
「Then I'll take on watching over $$ゼクス$$」

stage0025_03:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$ルカ$$
「So you've joined us too, Miss $$ノイン$$.」

stage0025_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$ノイン$$
「The $$プリベンター$$s exist to preserve peace,
　and that work was meant to be done
　out of the public eye...」

stage0025_03:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$ノイン$$
「But unfortunately, things are
　accelerating. Regrettably, I intend to
　become a force for peace myself too.」

stage0025_03:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I've been transferred from the $$ラー・カイラム$$
　to the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ as well.
　Count on me again, everyone」

stage0025_03:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Have you changed a bit, Captain?」

stage0025_03:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I've reached the age where stress shows on my face.」

stage0025_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Heh, don't feel sorry for me.
　Though I'm hardly one to talk myself.」

stage0025_03:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Good timing. Let's introduce the
　new recruit to everyone.
　...$$バナージ$$!」

stage0025_03:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
Banagher
「I'm $$バナージ・リンクス$$.
　I'm currently working as a test pilot
　for the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$」

stage0025_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$バナージ$$ got caught up in the Neo Zeon
　terrorist attack on Industrial 7...」

stage0025_03:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He fought in that $$ユニコーンガンダム$$,
　and ended up joining us on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$」

stage0025_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Unicorn, huh...that white one-horned
　mobile suit from over there...」

stage0025_03:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$ルカ$$
「It looks a bit different from the other Gundams.」

stage0025_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「That's where you'd be wrong!
　That Unicorn transforms」

stage0025_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「That single horn splits into a V-fin,
　and parts all over it deploy too,
　and a proper Gundam is born.」

stage0025_03:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But for the Unicorn to transform,
　a system called the NT-D has to activate,
　and the conditions for that are still unknown」

stage0025_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So it can't just transform freely then?」

stage0025_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right.
　That's part of why we have $$バナージ$$
　working as a test pilot, to figure it out」

stage0025_03:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$...!
　Stop revealing classified matters to civilians!」

stage0025_03:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$アムロ$$
「They're comrades we'll be fighting alongside.
　Wanting to share basic information about
　a wingman seems only natural, don't you think?」

stage0025_03:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That may be so, but...」

stage0025_03:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't worry, $$アルベルト$$.
　I think I understand Anaheim's situation too.
　I won't do anything to hurt the company's interests」

stage0025_03:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Very well, then, that's fine.
　Now, if you'll excuse me...」

stage0025_03:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's $$アルベルト・ビスト$$.
　An Anaheim executive.」

stage0025_03:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That's the type who hides behind power
　to get his way. A textbook snob.」

stage0025_03:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「That old man's supposed to be watching
　over the Unicorn, but he's full of complaints
　about $$バナージ$$ being the test pilot」

stage0025_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Can't be helped.
　The Unicorn can only be piloted by $$バナージ$$,
　since it's keyed to his biometric data」

stage0025_03:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$バナージ$$
（This possibility, entrusted to me by
　$$カーディアス・ビスト$$... by my father... I'll
　protect $$オードリー$$ with that Unicorn...）

stage0025_03:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Well... thanks to them wanting $$バナージ$$
　as pilot, me and $$ミコット$$ and $$オードリー$$
　all got hired along with him too」

stage0025_03:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$アルト$$
「I see.
　So that's why you and that girl
　are aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ too.」

stage0025_03:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$ミコット$$
「$$沙慈$$ and I got separated
　during the fighting on Industrial 7, though...」

stage0025_03:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$アルト$$
「Knowing him,
　I'm sure he's fine.」

stage0025_03:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So, and who might you be...?」

stage0025_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
Audrey
「My name is $$オードリー・バーン$$.
　Pleased to meet you」

stage0025_03:r_6d287e4652a3781f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「She got caught up in the fighting too,
　and with nowhere else to go, she came
　aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ with us」

stage0025_03:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$クラン$$
「I see...
　Sounds like you've had a rough time.」

stage0025_03:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you for your concern」

stage0025_03:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Nice.
　That elegance just radiates off you.」

stage0025_03:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「You... could you be someone of
　high birth? A princess of a fallen nation...」

stage0025_03:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's leave that sort of thing alone.
　From now on, we've got no choice but
　to make this work here on this ship」

stage0025_03:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$クラン$$
「$$バナージ$$'s right, $$ミシェル$$!
　The moment you see a cute girl you
　always try to butter them up like that...!」

stage0025_03:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Alright, alright.
　No need to get that mad over a joke.」

stage0025_03:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you, $$バナージ$$.
　For throwing me a lifeline」

stage0025_03:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$オードリー$$ seems to have some kind of past,
　but I won't think about that now...
　she chose to come with us...）

stage0025_03:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アムロ$$...
　are you sure you shouldn't tell everyone about that?」

stage0025_03:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Could that really...
　not be Captain $$クワトロ$$ after all...?」

stage0025_03:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I denied it, but the unease remains.
　Telling $$甲児$$ and the others now
　would only cause needless confusion」

stage0025_03:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$... where are you right now...
　I believe you won't make a foolish choice...）

stage0025_03:r_3888ccd5f98dd99d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So, the super robot team
　went to $$第３新東京市$$, huh?」

stage0025_03:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$甲児$$
「We were fighting monsters called Angels there」

stage0025_03:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$マオ$$
「That famous red sea of theirs,
　I always wanted to see for myself」

stage0025_03:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$宗介$$
「The red sea...
　The one that won't mix with the sea around it...」

stage0025_03:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$さやか$$
「According to hyperspace physicists,
　that's apparently because the world brought here
　by the $$新世時空震動$$ hasn't blended in」

stage0025_03:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$マオ$$
「I heard the red sea comes from a third world,
　after $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$, if I recall...」

stage0025_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's right.
　In that world, its sea turned red from a disaster
　fifteen years back called $$セカンドインパクト$$.」

stage0025_03:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So it transferred here via the $$新世時空震動$$,
　but the world itself hasn't blended in well.」

stage0025_03:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「The world hasn't blended in...?
　What's that mean?」

stage0025_03:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Guess you just take it at face value.
　That red sea's phase is apparently off, so
　it won't mix with this world's sea.」

stage0025_03:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$マオ$$
「Hmm...
　So with just a small trigger,
　that third world might shift again」

stage0025_03:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$葵$$
「Well, given how stable the dimensional
　boundary is now, a $$時空震動$$ won't happen easily.」

stage0025_03:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$クルツ$$
「The problem's probably that rumored Angel」

stage0025_03:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah.
　If an Angel reaches NERV HQ in $$第３新東京市$$,
　Third Impact happens and the world ends.」

stage0025_03:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Whoa, hold on a second!
　What do you mean, the world ends...!?」

stage0025_03:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$マオ$$
「What's the principle behind
　this Third Impact thing anyway?」

stage0025_03:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$くらら$$
「That's the thing, we haven't been told either」

stage0025_03:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$葵$$
「NERV, the group set up to intercept Angels,
　seems pretty secretive about a lot of things」

stage0025_03:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$葵$$
「So neither about the Angels
　nor about that Third Impact
　has any information come down to us」

stage0025_03:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$マオ$$
「Still, NERV's really something...
　Only a few months in this world,
　and already wielding that much power...」

stage0025_03:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
$$赤木$$
「But it's not all bad, you know.
　That Commander Ikari guy went and sent the
　Crusher Team his prized Evangelion.」

stage0025_03:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
Akagi
「A pro at dealing with 《$$ヘテロダイン$$》,
　$$赤木駿介$$ of $$２１世紀警備保障$$'s
　PR Section 2, pilot of $$ダイ・ガード$$」

stage0025_03:r_b267a0ec877acc0e.text:
Ibuki
「Also here, I'm the navigator, $$桃井いぶき$$.」

stage0025_03:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
Aoyama
「I'm the engineer, $$青山圭一郎$$.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0025_03:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$宗介$$
「A pro knows a pro...
　It seems that man and $$クルツ$$
　have recognized each other」

stage0025_03:r_ede6dd5bb2efe029.text:
$$マオ$$
「Better not to ask, I think.
　Just a hunch, though」

stage0025_03:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Feels like we'll know each other a while, $$青山$$」

stage0025_03:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$青山$$
「Seems that way.
　Good to know you, $$クルツ$$」

stage0025_03:r_e81e034b71411af7.text:
$$赤木$$
「Not sure I follow,
　but hitting it off is a good thing」

stage0025_03:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$マオ$$
「I've heard about your exploits.
　Civilians who are pros at dealing
　with $$ヘテロダイン$$s, they say」

stage0025_03:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$青山$$
「Though thanks to the boundary being stable,
　《$$界震$$s》 barely happen at all,
　so here we are, in the Crusher Team」

stage0025_03:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't complain, $$青山$$.
　It's a good thing $$ヘテロダイン$$s aren't showing up...」

stage0025_03:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$赤木$$
「Above all, let's be glad we get to work
　for peace with the Crusher Team.」

stage0025_03:r_718d4f86b37b2915.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well said, Mr. Japanese salaryman.
　This guy's a real hero of justice, huh」

stage0025_03:r_2cd57aac659672dc.text:
$$赤木$$
「Hold on a second.
　I'm not the only salaryman protecting peace.
　It's all of PR Section 2.」

stage0025_03:r_017c609cb5528ca1.text:
$$大杉$$
「I'm $$大杉$$, the section chief.
　We've formally accepted the Far East Branch's
　request, and will be accompanying you all.」

stage0025_03:r_984737d2920b03f7.text:
Yokozawa
「I'm $$横沢晋也$$, assistant section chief.
　These are the section's members」

stage0025_03:r_5ce10ef5943775df.text:
Ooyama
「I'm $$大山紀子$$.
　Following on from $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, I'm helping out
　with the Crusher Team.」

stage0025_03:r_444bfe868b096710.text:
Nakahara
「I'm $$中原千秋$$.
　I'll do my very best.」

stage0025_03:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
Tanigawa
「I'm $$谷川風花$$.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0025_03:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
Irie
「I'm $$入江静香$$.
　Pleased to make your acquaintance.」

stage0025_03:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
Ishizuka
「I'm $$石塚智美$$.
　And these are $$田口友朗$$ and $$伊集院博孝$$.」

stage0025_03:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$伊集院$$
「Nice to meetcha.
　A pleasure to meet you.」

stage0025_03:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
Saeki
「Last but not least, I'm $$佐伯徹$$,
　dispatched by the military as a tactical
　advisor. I mainly direct $$ダイ・ガード$$'s operations.」

stage0025_03:r_1054a335fa977a7a.text:
$$マオ$$
「You all seem awfully close, don't you」

stage0025_03:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$青山$$
「Though it's more like we all got dragged
　here by $$赤木$$'s justice-freak tendencies」

stage0025_03:r_b302a6e2e0ca76ec.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It's fine, isn't it?
　It's got 'justice' stuck on the front, after all.」

stage0025_03:r_e4166e8a5b45cb96.text:
$$大杉$$
「We're not the only ones who got swept up
　by $$赤木$$'s guts, you know.
　These two are the rumored Evangelion pilots」

stage0025_03:r_bdfc9cb5d9aaf4ce.text:
Shinji
「Pilot of $$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$,
　I'm $$碇シンジ$$.」

stage0025_03:r_cb789b091a7a05ca.text:
$$マオ$$
「Ikari... any relation to NERV's commander?」

stage0025_03:r_5430d9d76e38cf47.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Yeah.
　$$シンジ$$'s Commander Ikari's son.」

stage0025_03:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
Misato
「I'm Lt. Col. Katsuragi of NERV.
　I've been put in charge of EVA operations
　and seconded to the Crusher Team」

stage0025_03:r_63bcb74b5bb605c9.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Don't worry too much about rank.
　This unit's got people from all sorts of
　organizations, so let's keep it casual.」

stage0025_03:r_b661c876eb7a4d72.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So, the kids around here
　just call me $$ミサト$$」

stage0025_03:r_99128140e453d460.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Then, as a grown man, allow me
　to call you $$ミサト$$...
　with plenty of feeling」

stage0025_03:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I think you and I will get along, Sergeant $$マオ$$.
　...So, you like beer, is that right?」

stage0025_03:r_4f98756e8506f766.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Heh... I could almost say I work
　just so I can drink beer」

stage0025_03:r_722be3d36da4979c.text:
$$マオ$$
「Understood.
　Then once the next operation succeeds...」

stage0025_03:r_4f838d45a89974f0.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Not just one, let's have as many as we want」

stage0025_03:r_99e939138611b349.text:
$$宗介$$
「So pros have met here too...」

stage0025_03:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$ミサト$$
「And this here is the Evangelion
　Unit-00 pilot, $$綾波レイ$$」

stage0025_03:r_c01f3d97d765f442.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh... a mysterious girl...!
　This'll be fun to watch in 2 to 3 years」

stage0025_03:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$クルツ$$
「...Sousuke... I'm leaving this one to you」

stage0025_03:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$$ナオト$$
「$$タケル$$, read their minds with telepathy
　and translate for them」

stage0025_03:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$$タケル$$
「Don't ask the impossible.
　I can't use my powers for that」

stage0025_03:r_d85829b2f9bff450.text:
$$タケル$$
「Nice to meet you all from $$ミスリル$$.
　We're members of the Crusher Team」

stage0025_03:r_d45ebbbfa8153f69.text:
$$マオ$$
「The unit under Director $$大塚$$
　of the Far East branch, right?」

stage0025_03:r_518305c95e4d1da4.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「Until recently, with the Frontier fleet's
　help, we were using Fold Wave observation
　to survey the state of space」

stage0025_03:r_78ebe98c49194738.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Investigating the state of the boundary?」

stage0025_03:r_85121e18387bbee9.text:
$$タケル$$
「No...
　we were checking the black hole at the galaxy's core」

stage0025_03:r_58b16d8cc9b8a2a5.text:
Takeru
「Oh, I forgot to introduce myself.
　I'm $$明神タケル$$...
　I pilot $$ゴッドマーズ$$, and my space name is Mars」

stage0025_03:r_7c9a719cd8f27d1d.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'm not from Earth.
　I'm from planet Gishin. Mars is the name I got there」

stage0025_03:r_808269c7e458f2a5.text:
Takeru
「As a kid, I was sent to Earth from planet Gishin,
　and a couple there, the Myojins, took me in
　and gave me the name $$明神タケル$$」

stage0025_03:r_f6f98a8ef73d1d43.text:
$$マオ$$
「A psychic on top of it all...
　This should come in handy」

stage0025_03:r_3d395121b4205722.text:
$$タケル$$
「I intend to use $$ゴッドマーズ$$ and my psychic powers
　for the sake of peace in the universe.
　I look forward to working with you all」

stage0025_03:r_9496bdb991cf236a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Another hero of justice after $$赤木$$, huh.
　Likewise, nice to meet you」

stage0025_03:r_980e935235423ee4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Now, let me introduce the rest of the Crusher Team」

stage0025_03:r_dc9b1e7f62a8afc8.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「I'm $$ロゼ$$.
　I'm not from Earth either, but I'm helping
　Mars, who fights for peace」

stage0025_03:r_a93aa11c23414e87.text:
$$マオ$$
「Hmm... so you're helping him personally」

stage0025_03:r_cbab585f941e5667.text:
$$宗介$$
「What do you mean by that?」

stage0025_03:r_0e1caed2ba333f4e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Sorry, $$ロゼ$$.
　Our silent-type sergeant here
　doesn't seem to get the situation」

stage0025_03:r_06e36bd71f54f272.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Won't you use that cute mouth of yours
　to explain your relationship with $$タケル$$?」

stage0025_03:r_978bd43401f7be8a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Cut it out, $$クルツ$$.
　Harassment gets you punished hard」

stage0025_03:r_e9bd6b1804d36e0a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Shouldn't a handsome guy's dirty jokes
　be excused as jokes, Boss?」

stage0025_03:r_1f65c397b9d1833d.text:
$$マオ$$
「To $$ロゼ$$, every man besides $$タケル$$
　is worth exactly the same」

stage0025_03:r_7aac40a4f34dcec3.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「That's... not quite what I meant...」

stage0025_03:r_371b88cba6c82378.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah, yeah, thanks for the show」

stage0025_03:r_4cb558f092561fde.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$ロゼ$$ rides in the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ too,
　and fights alongside us」

stage0025_03:r_119dbefe27cdac46.text:
Naoto
「And the $$コスモクラッシャー$$'s gunner
　is me, $$伊集院ナオト$$」

stage0025_03:r_56176fc60ad96ecd.text:
Mika
「I'm the comms officer, $$日向ミカ$$」

stage0025_03:r_160384a0c68215c6.text:
Kenji
「And I'm the Crusher Team's captain, $$飛鳥ケンジ$$」

stage0025_03:r_577385dbd6d74922.text:
$$クルツ$$
「With this much firepower gathered,
　whatever that Demon King thing is,
　we've got nothing to fear」

stage0025_03:r_ee134f0fa96047a6.text:
$$甲児$$
「Well then, $$シンジ$$, $$レイ#333$$...
　don't forget about tomorrow after school」

stage0025_03:r_3569c3ca91ae0f9d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I see...
　So $$シンジ$$ and $$レイ#333$$ transferred to
　a school here in $$第２新東京市$$ too, huh.」

stage0025_03:r_497aca854c5f874d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes.
　Leave the two of them to me and the Volunteer Club.」

stage0025_03:r_1797d61f82be363c.text:
$n
「...Thanks, but I've been busy lately,
　so I'll take care of my own errand.」

stage0025_03:r_f2e19618032127d3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I see...
　Then I'll say hello to everyone for you.」

stage0025_03:r_9d5428667d48c806.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But don't forget about tomorrow after school.
　The new Volunteer Club members are meeting
　Miss Chidori then.」

stage0025_03:r_21454fd877c0ae7b.text:
$n
「...Sorry.
　I don't think I can make that either.」

stage0025_03:r_402b4aaf0ee30986.text:
$$アルト$$
「Now then, the new Volunteer Club members
　will introduce themselves to the manager.」

stage0025_03:r_2cfc9851abe4070e.text:
Toji
「$$第２新東京市$$ Jr. High No. 1, Year 2 Class A,
　$$鈴原トウジ$$! Nobody beats me on guts!」

stage0025_03:r_0831afdf480052ed.text:
Kensuke
「Same class, Year 2 A. $$相田ケンスケ$$.
　My hobbies are all things military, and photography.」

stage0025_03:r_1c9bf7ffbf9314a5.text:
Hikari
「Junior High No. 1, Year 2 Class A, $$洞木ヒカリ$$.
　I was in the same class as Suzuhara back in $$第３新東京市$$.」

stage0025_03:r_adc5793509f8d46c.text:
Kaname
「Very well...!
　I'm $$千鳥かなめ$$, Year 2 Class 4,
　Jindai High's Volunteer Club manager.」

stage0025_03:r_f581e32ff0b84e01.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$アルト$$, our president, told me all about you.
　I look forward to working with you all.」

stage0025_03:r_c5ffa17ba0fae8d3.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Nice to meet you, senior!」

stage0025_03:r_b251d2d3a7cdba85.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Senior...
　Ahh... I love the sound of that.」

stage0025_03:r_abc1d4645695a0e0.text:
$$アルト$$
「The school doesn't know that we fight.
　This Volunteer Club is partly a cover story
　to help hide that fact.」

stage0025_03:r_ae527ac0a641a269.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's why you keep it secret that $$シンジ$$
　and $$レイ#333$$ pilot the Evas too. It'll just
　cause unnecessary trouble otherwise.」

stage0025_03:r_b76534e2de5b6334.text:
$$トウジ$$
「We're already well aware of that!」

stage0025_03:r_ee41ea400d1ee0bf.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm counting on you, $$トウジ$$.
　You lot look out for $$シンジ$$ and $$レイ#333$$.」

stage0025_03:r_a5181af1cc2bdd02.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「He's a kid at heart.
　He loves this secret-squadron kind of thing.」

stage0025_03:r_357749a704e3cf55.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So, where's the man of the hour, $$碇シンジ$$?」

stage0025_03:r_9da55d8320b82bc6.text:
$$トウジ$$
「That guy got nabbed by the school
　counselor after class.」

stage0025_03:r_8d5dbaa0f1e069de.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「The counselor's the vice-homeroom teacher, right?
　Bit of a busybody...」

stage0025_03:r_7accc1b1cfd86010.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「Don't say that.
　Mr. $$扇$$ is a dedicated, kind person.」

stage0025_03:r_59a1074cc884fdbd.text:
$$クラン$$
「Isn't his hair kind of shaggy up front?」

stage0025_03:r_b66bbe1f07a7674e.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「That's about right.
　I hear Mr. $$扇$$ transferred in from 《$$新日本$$》
　around the same time we did.」

stage0025_03:r_39d8b5a2657c65a4.text: ～ Municipal Junior High School No. 1 Classroom ～

stage0025_03:r_1a123affe838b8b1.text:
$$扇$$
「Sorry, Ikari.
　For keeping you after class.」

stage0025_03:r_f9ff2a77c392a048.text:
$$扇$$
「Didn't you have somewhere to be?
　Suzuhara and the others said something about it...」

stage0025_03:r_3167d694c10c96fb.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's fine.
　It wasn't anything important.」

stage0025_03:r_5dcadcd6c77bc7dc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Um... did you need something from me?」

stage0025_03:r_f22e056851da9461.text:
$$扇$$
「Don't take it so seriously.
　We're both new to $$第２新東京市$$, so just
　humor me with some small talk.」

stage0025_03:r_97923e3dd5dae64b.text:
$$扇$$
「Sounds like $$第３新東京市$$ was rough.」

stage0025_03:r_286cd6be5271ecd2.text:
$$扇$$
「I'm from 《$$新日本$$》 myself.
　I've seen the fighting up close, more than once.」

stage0025_03:r_912c58272c320559.text:
$$扇$$
「The school's been told, at least, that
　you and Ayanami pilot that weapon,
　the Evangelion.」

stage0025_03:r_378632856490e9d0.text:
$$扇$$
「Truth is, I've been on a battlefield myself.
　This bandana is sort of a memento from there.」

stage0025_03:r_0a93eeae43e226f4.text:
$$扇$$
「And on that battlefield,
　I saw kids around your age fighting,
　more times than I can count...」

stage0025_03:r_5d3ee1804aedfa48.text:
$$扇$$
「But you and Ayanami are a bit different from them...
　and that's what's been bothering me.」

stage0025_03:r_b99c671eb373edd1.text:
$$扇$$
「...Ikari, could it be that...
　you really don't want to fight?」

stage0025_03:r_0f9b6f684aa8f438.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...If I said I didn't want to fight,
　could you make it so I don't have to?」

stage0025_03:r_cd3b88564d0672c9.text:
$$扇$$
「But I think I can still help you.」

stage0025_03:r_a671f14759794503.text:
$$カレン$$
「Oh... sorry, $$扇$$.
　Were you still working?」

stage0025_03:r_7ff5aecfd0f37b20.text:
$$扇$$
「No, it's fine.
　I was actually just about to talk about you.」

stage0025_03:r_121b55dcb47984aa.text:
Kallen
「Let me introduce myself.
　I'm $$紅月カレン$$...
　From 《$$新日本$$》, same as $$扇$$.」

stage0025_03:r_0c472072ac8bda60.text:
$$カレン$$
「I used to go to a school in $$新日本$$
　called $$アッシュフォード学園$$, but now I'm
　studying abroad at Jindai High here.」

stage0025_03:r_a378a46f62b5980d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Jindai High...
　That's the school $$甲児$$ and the others go to.」

stage0025_03:r_87e728176c45393f.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$カレン$$!
　It really is you, $$カレン$$!」

stage0025_03:r_5aa4e72c511af6eb.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$甲児$$, $$アルト$$!
　And everyone else too!」

stage0025_03:r_8e2f92d078970a2b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, this is a surprise.
　Came to say hi to $$扇$$ and ran into $$カレン$$ too.」

stage0025_03:r_e8ecfd162319c1e6.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Must be nice, $$シンジ$$.
　Thought you were stuck with some dull chat
　with Mr. $$扇$$, but you know a fine lady like her?」

stage0025_03:r_5c0f74cc35812a77.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I only just met her myself, just now.」

stage0025_03:r_0bb68446ec330a05.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't let her fool you, $$トウジ$$.
　This $$カレン$$ used to be a fierce ace known
　as the 'Red Devil'.」

stage0025_03:r_86f0e9b721a4f655.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Then, this is the person Mr. $$扇$$ meant...」

stage0025_03:r_84158af5a79e4d35.text:
$$甲児$$
「Oh, right, $$扇$$!
　Are you done talking with $$シンジ$$?」

stage0025_03:r_c42f7ca81fe0cf88.text:
$$扇$$
「Yeah.
　Ikari should be fine with you lot around.」

stage0025_03:r_4c845bb8b05d3b13.text:
$$扇$$
「$$カレン$$... look after Ikari for me.」

stage0025_03:r_ebc3eec9f9e218b1.text:
$$甲児$$
「All right, let's go, $$シンジ$$!
　$$カレン$$, you come along too!」

stage0025_03:r_b40fe3d3e6f2b1d9.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Truth is... there's someone among our
　friends whose conduct we can't quite figure out.」

stage0025_03:r_778c6eb2f5afc622.text:
$$アルト$$
「We're the Volunteer Club, after all.
　If they've wandered onto a dark path,
　we've got to help them out.」

stage0025_03:r_3fb74a41e682c7de.text:
$$カレン$$
「I don't really get it, but
　do you know where they are?」

stage0025_03:r_47c1edbfd5664fd7.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　The tracking marker I prepared for
　a time like this will serve its purpose.」

stage0025_03:r_fbdb8764f80a1b12.text:
$$宗介$$
「I too had doubts about their conduct.
　I attached a transmitter without them noticing.」

stage0025_03:r_d1b8cb87f8ea00d6.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's amazing, $$宗介$$.
　With this, we can pinpoint their location perfectly.」

stage0025_03:r_bba76accfb31e66d.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「So this is $$ミスリル$$'s fearsome technology!」

stage0025_03:r_199a6e6247ffb58b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Sousuke...
　Were you... using this to spy on me?」

stage0025_03:r_6095c82e60cdd7af.text:
$$宗介$$
「I intended to use it, depending on the situation.」

stage0025_03:r_ad702e22165a11de.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Let me tell you something!
　Even if it's for my protection, I will not
　stand for this stalker-like nonsense!」

stage0025_03:r_df79b5dc7ceda4c0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Now, now, Miss Chidori.
　Thanks to this, we can track $n's
　movements, so let it slide this time.」

stage0025_03:r_48a06834bb510d7d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Doesn't Miss $$スズネ$$ know
　where $n is headed either?」

stage0025_03:r_f19a063712278769.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Yeah...
　I noticed $n was heading out
　somewhere about once a week, but...」

stage0025_03:r_48fd2b5d0978ba1c.text:
$$アルト$$
「Missions have kept us busy lately.
　Today's the first free time we've had,
　so he's probably headed there now.」

stage0025_03:r_90591ae4aa6d92d6.text:
$$カレン$$
「Playing detective, huh? Sounds fun.
　Let's go, $$シンジ$$.」

stage0025_03:r_bff5468c57365d6b.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$扇$$ asked me to look after you.
　So from today, I'm playing big sister to $$シンジ$$.」

stage0025_03:r_9dc3c6963e7dac77.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Lucky you, $$シンジ$$!
　I wish I could trade places with you!」

stage0025_03:r_173107393504e4d1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Then Sousuke can be like
　a big brother to you, $$トウジ$$.」

stage0025_03:r_e839f83a2e7828b1.text:
$$宗介$$
「Understood.
　My instruction will be strict, Suzuhara.」

stage0025_03:r_7d5585f6d8b1df8d.text:
$$扇$$
「I heard about the Volunteer Club's activities
　from Miss Suzune on your side.
　Do your best, Ikari, Suzuhara, Aida, Horaki, Ayanami.」

stage0025_03:r_bd5c0088c2d22ef6.text:
$$宗介$$
「Confirmed.
　His location is the municipal hospital.」

stage0025_03:r_a8286dce43de45a6.text:
$$マキ$$
「No change.
　Neither better nor worse...」

stage0025_03:r_e4dc8237ad7169a2.text:
$$マキ$$
「Hey, $n...
　You don't have to push yourself anymore.」

stage0025_03:r_dda2f4922920a4e0.text:
$$マキ$$
「Just between us, even the doctor has
　given up on $$シンヤ$$ and $$ミサコ$$.」

stage0025_03:r_02b69055356d9cfb.text:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry, $n...
　I didn't mean to make light of it...」

stage0025_03:r_c4554163734c62f1.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アルト$$ has no reason to apologize.
　I planted the tracker.」

stage0025_03:r_890ab04baf542979.text:
$n
「...It's fine.
　Not telling anyone where I was going is on me too.」

stage0025_03:r_4bea4465e893e4b0.text:
$$マキ$$
「$n... and who might these be?」

stage0025_03:r_0b8e88db1a9dd44e.text:
$$マキ$$
「Nice to meet you all.
　I'm $$柏葉真紀$$, the nurse in charge
　of $$シンヤ$$ and $$ミサコ$$.」

stage0025_03:r_a4798a17c691a81a.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$シンヤ$$ and $$ミサコ$$... those two, huh...」

stage0025_03:r_533e554662b8c631.text:
$$マキ$$
「Those two's hearts have already died.」

stage0025_03:r_cbff35a90e8ad7cd.text:
$n
「Their bodies are alive.
　But joy, anger, sorrow, happiness...
　they've lost every one of those feelings.」

stage0025_03:r_26db4dd6c24f9835.text:
$$アルト$$
「You... you've been visiting those two...」

stage0025_03:r_397bc0c659cbf227.text:
$$カレン$$
「What's wrong, all of a sudden!?」

stage0025_03:r_4fec64c622a0514b.text:
$$マキ$$
「Calm down, $n!
　I'll get the doctor, now!」

stage0025_03:r_a6b5f5b4b8ab58f8.text:
$$カレン$$
「A $$時空震動$$'s about to hit...!?」

stage0025_03:r_023f1f7532dd508f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Looks like it's starting, $$アンナロッタ$$...」

stage0025_03:r_3a4a5d03e079f53d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's been a while since I stepped out
　under the sun. Don't disappoint me now...」

stage0025_03:r_4711ef8ef992a14e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$n...
　Tell me about the $$ジェニオン$$'s hidden functions.」

stage0025_03:r_ca13a7fc435dcc9d.text:
$n
「...I don't know either.
　I was fighting for my life, and the $$ジェニオン$$
　just moved and transformed on its own...」

stage0025_03:r_58564bddc1ac08b5.text:
$n
「After that, I was just fighting on instinct.」

stage0025_03:r_e2efb08e47011ced.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You're a $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation agent.
　Don't you know either?」

stage0025_03:r_d1f368432258ec05.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes...
　The prototype $$ジェニオン$$ has a lot of black-box parts,
　and I'm at a loss too.」

stage0025_03:r_6330bf8e56b514cf.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Can't we force the transformation system
　to activate, and analyze it that way?」

stage0025_03:r_7317f048fc262114.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If we mishandle it, something irreversible
　could happen, so that's...」

stage0025_03:r_3efe6b08505e6b39.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Same as Unicorn's NT-D, huh...
　can't touch it.」

stage0025_03:r_889b93ef12326ef0.text:
$$オズマ$$
「But running an unknown system is a problem.
　Depending on the case, we may seal the $$ジェニオン$$...」

stage0025_03:r_36ba6439169b2472.text:
$n
「The transformed $$ジェニオン$$ put out power
　far beyond its normal output.
　That's an advantage for the squad too.」

stage0025_03:r_d19e2d3230e09c6a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I wonder...
　The fact is, you the pilot couldn't
　control it, and passed out in the end.」

stage0025_03:r_807f7b4a12c3c6ab.text:
$n
「Then I just need to learn to control it.」

stage0025_03:r_ac913a939029996b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「What do you think, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

stage0025_03:r_31efa01531be032d.text:
$$オズマ$$
「You're a $$ジェニオン$$ crew member too.
　I want to hear your opinion.」

stage0025_03:r_d9f2b8012ba37fc5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm not giving up my own will.
　As his partner, I consider
　supporting him my top priority.」

stage0025_03:r_cdf86c7be0122aaf.text:
$$オズマ$$
「...$$ＡＧ$$, just report what you can.
　Submit a report on that system
　of the $$ジェニオン$$'s.」

stage0025_03:r_62cbe4ab456fe01c.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'll base my report to the captains on that.」

stage0025_03:r_f60d86deb9f0ed30.text:
$$アムロ$$
「There's also that mystery enemy calling itself 'G'.
　More strength on hand can't hurt.」

stage0025_03:r_92a92fbd8a2b734e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Brass decided to call that thing 'Unknown G',
　shortened to 'UG', apparently.」

stage0025_03:r_05ebe641ed2da125.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Until we know their next move, we stay on alert.
　Get $$ＡＧ$$ and the $$ジェニオン$$ serviced.」

stage0025_03:r_a65f2c6073076762.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$n...
　I respect your will to grow stronger.」

stage0025_03:r_4bc0637364d8a149.text:
$$オズマ$$
「So the problem inside you,
　you overcome it yourself.」

stage0025_03:r_e93d2827733385fa.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's fine.
　My feelings are just as I told Major $$オズマ$$.」

stage0025_03:r_891efb3059812af8.text:
$n
「Even so, I want to say thank you.」

stage0025_03:r_299ce4b54f92ed39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Then tell me...
　how your red eyes tie to those two at the hospital.」

stage0025_03:r_18c345e4b68c12c7.text:
$$アルト$$
「We want to hear it too.」

stage0025_03:r_91b7a61294c05a90.text:
$$甲児$$
「As comrades who'll keep fighting together.」

stage0025_03:r_ec02d70600f29cb1.text:
$n
「...I don't really know the truth of it.」

stage0025_03:r_9071778073533579.text:
$n
「I think that $$シンヤ$$, $$ミサコ$$,
　and I are all cursed, too...」

stage0025_03:r_5f7d81050a6eb0d2.text:
$n
「...It was near the end of the $$再世戦争$$...
　Back then, I was living in the Rocky
　Mountains with my dad and my sister.」

stage0025_03:r_c5d14cea3feb3258.text:
$n
「One night... it happened without warning...
　We heard a strange ringing, and went outside.」

stage0025_03:r_94c58684d3d2f2cc.text:
$n
「At that moment, a dimensional tremor hit,
　and my dad and sister...」

stage0025_03:r_cdb2805b3e42414b.text:
$$スズネ$$
（$n's family died in the Spacequake disaster,
　and only $n survived...）

stage0025_03:r_90c004166d6998d3.text:
$n
「The next thing I knew, I woke up in a hospital bed.」

stage0025_03:r_d1593dddba79767f.text:
$n
「My dad's and sister's final voices
　still remain inside me, even now.」

stage0025_03:r_d940e68fde96e892.text:
$n
「Words can't describe it...
　But... if I had to force it into words
　I already know, to describe that thing...」

stage0025_03:r_d4539352ead4c516.text:
$n
「In the dimensional tremor's light...
　an angel... was laughing...」

stage0025_03:r_028e78edf8b38c6c.text:
$n
「That's when it started...
　Whenever I recall that sight, my eyes...」

stage0025_03:r_cd169febb82df2fb.text:
$n
「Not through logic, but instinct,
　I became certain that thing caused the
　tremor that took my dad's and sister's lives.」

stage0025_03:r_69ec96fb8da7c25c.text:
$n
「I chased after that thing's true identity...
　And I learned there were others who survived
　tremor accidents, just like me.」

stage0025_03:r_9a22aa8d49b88417.text:
$n
「And that those people's eyes are stained with blood,
　just like mine...」

stage0025_03:r_112c133deaee5282.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So those are the two from the hospital room...」

stage0025_03:r_8075f8bcc76f7df8.text:
$$甲児$$
「Those kids had both eyes turn red.
　But only one of yours did...」

stage0025_03:r_ce4876c69922ab65.text:
$n
「I think that's because I only saw him for an instant.
　But conversely, if I'd looked straight at him...」

stage0025_03:r_e1a3d4cb622d1379.text:
$$アルト$$
「Would your heart have been killed too, like theirs...」

stage0025_03:r_947f475c9b344398.text:
$n
「I know what you're trying to say, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　My heart survived, but ever since that day
　I've been possessed by fear...」

stage0025_03:r_11d00beba857914c.text:
$n
「Maybe the reason I chase after him
　isn't to avenge Dad and the others...」

stage0025_03:r_b4b6f78fa1c50d56.text:
$n
「Maybe I'm just looking for a way
　to escape this fear...」

stage0025_03:r_6603b33ecc4f006c.text:
$n
「Even now, the angel's laugh stuck in my mind
　is assaulting my whole body...」

stage0025_03:r_b41738c2c296ec08.text:
$n
「Cover my ears, close my eyes, scream all I like,
　it just... won't let go...」

stage0025_03:r_2809477b354952d7.text:
$n
「That voice is... surely... consuming my mind...」

stage0025_03:r_70e2d7c09c997d80.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Is that why you tried to grow strong,
　in order to chase that angel...」

stage0025_03:r_33ca14bc62a8ea9e.text:
$n
「If I grow strong, I can escape the fear...
　Maybe I can avenge Dad and the others...」

stage0025_03:r_69d2b6ca8a9af483.text:
$n
「But the enemy's beyond human understanding...
　There's no way normal means can fight it...」

stage0025_03:r_c913e9b12c65ea83.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that's when you encountered the $$ジェニオン$$」

stage0025_03:r_d3c638baa229ea65.text:
$n
「Right now, the $$ジェニオン$$ is my only hope...
　Whatever it really is, the $$ジェニオン$$
　is all I have」

stage0025_03:r_37ddf9facc0bf611.text:
$n
「The enemy isn't human...
　There's no way normal means can win...」

stage0025_03:r_731c9dd791416eab.text:
$n
「So I'm betting everything on the $$ジェニオン$$.
　If I can master that power, surely...」

stage0025_03:r_19afcbf950a9cea2.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that occult obsession of yours
　was to gather info on that angel...」

stage0025_03:r_b3edb5df8a517f28.text:
$$宗介$$
「But why? You should have had
　the fear under control, yet just now
　you...」

stage0025_03:r_b6bf9ce8b93b16bb.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Could this be related to why
　those two suddenly went berserk?」

stage0025_03:r_8d1375c34ba16830.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The angel you were chasing was there?」

stage0025_03:r_d51e9ed1fd8496c5.text:
$$タケル$$
「Is that the Unknown who called itself 'G'?」

stage0025_03:r_5d05b9eadc4a190e.text:
$n
「I'm pathetic...
　Even as I talked about wanting to be strong,
　my heart was full of fear and despair...」

stage0025_03:r_7ae9b8fbbedf5dee.text:
$n
「If he's here, I should fight with the $$ジェニオン$$...
　My head knows that, but all that
　comes out of my mouth is screams」

stage0025_03:r_2bb1d8407f3ac7af.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But you did fight, didn't you.
　You got past that fear」

stage0025_03:r_61dc876016accae5.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$シンジ$$'s right.
　You fought admirably」

stage0025_03:r_df305a2342916c62.text:
$n
「I'm not like you all, fighting for peace,
　and I can't commit to being a pro either.
　I'm just a half-baked nobody...」

stage0025_03:r_ded3af19c14ef270.text:
$$甲児$$
「Didn't I tell you, $n?
　I was fighting to avenge my grandpa
　when I first started, you know」

stage0025_03:r_11ed17ac30eaf4e9.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Me? Still just protecting my company's vault」

stage0025_03:r_e5b6062db98e78ba.text:
$$カレン$$
「I was originally with the resistance,
　so all I needed was to take Japan back」

stage0025_03:r_8cf17d680a14f12c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「For me too, it started with personal feelings」

stage0025_03:r_c0cfc49d1cf3253b.text:
$$シン$$
「First I'm hearing of it, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0025_03:r_ec3afb65f0579128.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It was kind of embarrassing, so I never said it」

stage0025_03:r_ce2710e169c8638f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Everyone... is the same.
　Everyone started fighting for their own reasons...」

stage0025_03:r_ec365b30f337a99c.text:
$$タケル$$
「And now, we fight together toward the same goal」

stage0025_03:r_f0f31573186c8442.text:
$n
「Can I become like that too...
　Like all of you」

stage0025_03:r_4b90ce5d89aa8205.text:
$n
「Even a puny me, trembling in fear...」

stage0025_03:r_3c52ed9cc95a59a1.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Even now, aren't you fighting
　for peace, $n?」

stage0025_03:r_6856a5edd8614a50.text:
$$宗介$$
「Raise your head.
　You have the will to overcome fear, don't you?」

stage0025_03:r_c5d939bf0ab35301.text:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... this is my reason for fighting.
　...Will you still be my partner?」

stage0025_03:r_5ad54bf4c561f917.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Of course.
　I feel closer to you now than ever before」

stage0025_03:r_25b99a9fc834fca9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know if I really can, but
　together with the $$ジェニオン$$, I'll be your hope」

stage0025_03:r_1dbe0977faf01cd1.text:
$$宗介$$
「Your smile... first time I've seen it」

stage0025_03:r_3384ecef3f53fbad.text:
$n
「Same goes for you.
　Even a stone-face gets some charm when it smiles」

stage0025_03:r_6a02825cc269991d.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's a good smile, $$シンジ$$」

stage0025_03:r_876f8e0c409bcbad.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I feel like I too can fight, with these people」

stage0025_03:r_124d91e7c4f89ed0.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's the spirit.
　Come talk to your big sis if you're ever in trouble」

stage0025_03:r_7bc3541788ee7f2b.text:
$$トウジ$$
「This ain't the time for laid-back talk,
　bro!」

stage0025_03:r_8d129a79eba7a963.text:
$$かなめ$$
「A huge $$時空震動$$ hit the waterfront district!」

stage0025_03:r_d0cf938014bc3903.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「An unknown enemy appearing with a dimensional tremor,
　and now a new $$時空震動$$...」

stage0025_03:r_499261a74e833326.text:
$n
「Is that connected to him too... the angel...」

stage0025_03:r_38e88246aad9f576.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The mysterious enemy 'UG'...
　I have no idea what it really is,
　but it seems to be piloted by someone with emotions」

stage0025_03:r_5358782b9a37a49e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As proof, downing that female commander
　got us a good Z-Chip」

stage0025_03:r_c67c7ff17095f9f9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That amount... 150 Z!
　I'll add this to the squad's stock」

stage0025_03:r_47a795a982a2afe8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well now, an enemy threatening the peace
　is worrying, but as a dimensional trader,
　Z-Chips come first above all」

stage0025_03:r_e374cf10667cf8ca.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When they show up again,
　I'll be counting on you once more」

stage0025_03:r_5fec4569873dcb4a.text:
$n
「$$ＡＧ$$... you really don't know anything
　about that $$ジェニオン$$ function?」

stage0025_03:r_a946196c9e8c8818.text:
$n
「After all, I still can't fully trust you」

stage0025_03:r_eb9a86a85a255734.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, that's fair enough...
　a happy-go-lucky robot that showed up
　with a dimensional tremor isn't worth trusting」

stage0025_03:r_1ea0cdc9a509a196.text:
$n
「...But whatever your true nature may be,
　right now I can only rely on you and the $$ジェニオン$$」

stage0025_03:r_7f01e7a12d31b087.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... $n,
　seems like something's clicked for you」

stage0025_03:r_79859c4808e67a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood.
　If you're relying on me that much,
　I'll give it everything I've got too!」

stage0025_03:r_07c48732ddfefbf4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As for that mode of the Genion,
　I've named it the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$」

stage0025_03:r_a72dda11fc49eb97.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Glitter Armament Infinity...
　it means an armament that shines infinitely」

stage0025_03:r_16f921a2aca072d0.text:
$n
「...Shines...?
　One of those flashy made-up names, huh...」

stage0025_03:r_76d8b3fd8c2fb5c0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's not it at all!
　How rude!」

stage0025_03:r_82d4fe1f44ab9173.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That 'GAI' from before, plus being off the charts,
　and yoroi, armor. Put it together and it's 'GAI'」

stage0025_03:r_d2a27e0cf8f08853.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Right?
　If I learn anything about the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$,
　you'll be the first to know, $n」

stage0025_03:r_a6286a7903b6a161.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you notice anything in battle too, $n,
　please let me know」

stage0025_03:r_e244e86a736affd3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no sign of a pickup from $$ＤＥＭ$$.
　Since that's how it is, let's finish
　the $$ジェニオン$$ together, $n!」

stage0025_03:r_2df2e7ca3ea786f3.text:
$n
（If I can master that power, I...）

stage0025_03:r_7c8562a4597f362e.text:
$n
（Whatever the enemy is... I can fight...）

stage0025_03:r_26a1cf54903cfce0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, now that we've settled what's next,
　let's get going today too... business, business!」
